watch.summary: A streamer playing a prop hunt game is bewildered when opponents hide in ridiculous spots, including clipped inside a thin metal shelf rack.

beats.what: Streamer wonders how anyone is supposed to spot a player hiding on the ceiling.
Streamer shoots the player stuck high up near the roof.
Streamer desperately searches for the last player before time expires.
Time runs out, giving the hiding team the win.
Streamer discovers the last player was clipped directly inside a hollow metal shelf pillar.
Streamer shouts in disbelief that the opponent was hiding inside the frame.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: He's literally inside the freaking thing!
watch.why: The clip works due to the sheer absurdity of the opponent's unfindable hiding spot inside a tiny shelf column. The streamer's bewildered escalation from searching normally to discovering the glitchy spot delivers a clean comedic payoff.
